subject.statement: Pat Gelsinger is currently the CEO of Intel.

summary: As of 2026-10-01, Pat Gelsinger is NOT the CEO of Intel (VERDICT: FALSE). He served as Intel's CEO from February 15, 2021 until his retirement effective December 1, 2024, after which Intel was led by interim co‑CEOs David Zinsner and Michelle Johnston Holthaus.

findings.statement: Pat Gelsinger's full name is Patrick Paul Gelsinger and he was born on March 5, 1961.
Pat Gelsinger served as Intel's CEO from February 15, 2021 until his retirement effective December 1, 2024.
As of October 1, 2026, Pat Gelsinger is not Intel's CEO; the company is led by interim co‑CEOs David Zinsner and Michelle Johnston Holthaus.

conflict_notes: A single source (comparably.com) claims Pat Gelsinger is Intel's CEO, while multiple high‑weight sources (Intel press release, Wikipedia, finance.yahoo, LinkedIn, YouTube) state he retired effective December 1, 2024 and is no longer CEO. The comparably.com entry lacks a date and is outweighed by the consistent, recent evidence, so it is treated as outdated or erroneous.
